question: Which aligned source roles feed the prospectively compressed block11 H3 and block15 H5 suffix heads, and can three-role banks selected on one half reproduce them on the other?
data_status: No attention11 H3 or attention15 H5 source-term intervention outcome has been computed on either split. Head-output outcomes are open, but not their pattern-times-value source decomposition.

population_split.selection: First 16 A1/A2 rows in immutable builder order.
population_split.confirmation: Last 16 A1/A2 rows in immutable builder order.

frozen_design.partition: cue is the one changed token; last/period/determiner are cue+1/+2/+3; self is final query; other is every remaining causal source position through query.
frozen_design.selection_score: 0.5 * ((singleton-no_sources) + (all_sources-leave_one_out)); ties resolve by frozen role order.
frozen_design.fixed_context: Full carried and MLP boundary deltas remain present; only the dominant head's projected source-term delta varies.

predictions.pred_a_authority_split_capability_and_ex: All hashes/terminals, split hashes, native capability, native/manual, MLP4 tensor, attention term reconstruction, and all-source/single-head crossing closures pass.
predictions.pred_b_writer_and_head_control_recurrenc: Writer and all-source dominant-head controls recur within fixed tolerances with positive A1/A2 direction.
predictions.pred_c_positive_selection_source_signal: All-source minus no-source recovery is positive for both heads and each frozen selection returns exactly three distinct roles.
predictions.pred_d_disjoint_three_role_compression: On confirmation rows, each selected three-role bank retains at least 70% of the all-source-minus-no-source dominant-head increment and is positive in both A1 and A2.
predictions.pred_e_exact_coverage: Selection arms and writer plus confirmation arms and writer produce exactly 576 finite records within 84 forwards and 704 example evaluations, without fits, backwards, or updates.

terminal.screen: A-E pass: compile the two validated three-role source banks into the suffix circuit.
terminal.null: The run is valid and head controls recur, but one three-role bank fails disjoint compression.
terminal.invalid: Authority, split, capability, alignment, instrument, control recurrence, finiteness, coverage, or price fails.

efficiency: Two six-role selection sweeps and two disjoint three-role checks share one model load; raw token-position sweeps and full 64-way role factorials are avoided.
novelty: First leakage-controlled source-term compression inside the two confirmed dominant suffix heads.
